purpose: Distinguish a semantically incorrect /conf.gs fixture from a failure in native package verification or script activation.

static_source.format_observation: The workbench defines separate script slots: StartScript_Fail is stored as the conf.gs role and StartScript_Connector is stored as the con.png role.
format_details: The container starts with a big-endian signature length and raw RSA-SSL signature.
The signed stream is an outer-RC4-encrypted ZIP using the historical key already recovered from the client.
The ZIP contains .rk, .t, and compiled script entries.
The .rk value wraps a random 16-byte script key with the archive RSA key.
Compiled script entries are RC4-encrypted with that per-archive script key.
static_source.production_status: The helper source is a format lead and a local test fixture source. It does not prove that a current production endpoint still emits the same files or keys.

diagnostic_inputs.mode3_script_behavior: onCreated calls echo with the marker MODE3_FAIL_SCRIPT_REACHED

tls_leg.responder_observation: SSLZeroReturnError: TLS/SSL connection has been closed (EOF)
tls_leg.interpretation: Native certificate verification rejected the expired test chain before an HTTPS GET was sent.

game_leg.interpretation: The failure script is not expected to start a game connection. Its marker proves script activation instead of game-server handoff.

conclusion.safe_repair_conclusion: The old mode-3 package handoff is functional with the matching test key and a StartScript_Fail archive. Obtain an authorized current response before repairing the production client, and preserve certificate and package verification.

limitations: The diagnostic library trusts a private helper test public key so the local package can be checked without bypassing native RSA verification.
The local package used the failure-script role by design and therefore does not prove a game login.
The x86_64 emulator did not execute the ARM64 native member.
No remote host or production endpoint was contacted.
The local TLS responder does not expose the native numeric CyaSSL error value.
